item.descriptionTitle: Zen infused villas beside natural hot springs in China’s tea capital, Anxi
item.descriptionText:
Among the tea terraces of southern China you’ll find Elite Spring Villas – an exclusive resort celebrating historic Chinese culture. With heritage-inspired buildings set beside tranquil pools, this boutique hotel immerses you in the sights and sounds of nature. Leave the outside world behind and let the peace of this Zen retreat soothe mind, body and soul.

Stroll along pathways between gently bubbling fountains to your private villa. Each offers a contemporary take on authentic Chinese design, with atmospheric touches such as calming sandalwood incense. Expect spacious living and sleeping areas, and luxury hot tubs in some villas. Enjoy a dip in the open-air pool or a relaxing soak in the tea-infused hot springs. Then experience an authentic tea ceremony using freshly picked Anxi leaves. Local ingredients are also on the menu at the restaurant, where you can sample Min and Yue regional delicacies.

item.descriptionTitle: Located in Chaoyang, the central business district of Beijing
item.descriptionText:
A gleaming glass pyramid envelopes Hotel Éclat Beijing which is part of the architecturally striking Parkview Green development in Fangcaodi with designer boutiques, restaurants and cinemas. Modern, light and wonderfully spacious, this boutique hotel has a fitness centre and a stunning contemporary art collection.

This has to be one of the city’s most elegant hotels and the keyword here is privacy. The rooms are inordinately generous, many with a private terrace and some with their own pool. A truly astounding art collection includes pieces by Salvador Dali, Andy Warhol and Zeng Fangzhi.

The joy of staying here is the accessibility to designer shopping and a wealth of restaurants. Located in the heart of the Embassy District, the hotel is also within easy reach of the major city attractions and after a busy day sightseeing, the clubs and bars of Sanlitun are virtually on the doorstep.

item.descriptionTitle: Tranquil design meets the peace of nature in this beautifully appointed mountain hideaway
item.descriptionText:
Find yourself floating at Zi Yun Xuan Qing Resort & Spa, where serenity and sophistication are in perfect harmony, high in the misty embrace of China’s mountains. Designed as a sanctuary of glass, stone and timber, the resort melts into its natural surroundings, allowing sweeping valley views and shifting skies to become part of your every moment. A haven for year-round discovery, this exceptional space offers restorative calm, cultural immersion and effortless access to pristine hiking trails, tea terraces and timeless temples.

Begin your morning with a nourishing breakfast, as delicate regional flavours come with sunrise vistas. Wander out for a day of exploration, whether that’s meditative forest walks, an exploration of Taoist culture, or invigorating mountain treks that awaken both body and spirit. Return to the warm embrace of the hotel’s stunning open-air infinity pool, where the water reflects the endless sky. Then take your pick of restaurants, with sumptuous global options available, made from ingredients sourced from the hotel’s own organic gardens, and served in atmospheric surroundings. Wind down for the night with a perfectly mixed cocktail, served alongside gentle jazz in the hotel’s elegant bar.

item.title: YiuTeung Mansion
item.descriptionTitle: A peaceful haven in a city-centre setting in lively Chengdu
item.descriptionText:
Sometimes you find hotels that are all about balance. YiuTeung Mansion, in Chengdu, is one such retreat. Taking inspiration from traditional Chinese architecture and the city’s famous author, Ba Jin, it’s centred around an inner courtyard that gives it a truly tranquil feel. Yet it’s right in the middle of a thriving city. The sights, sounds and heat of Sichuan spice are right on your doorstep – all you have to do is dive in.

From the Deluxe rooms to the sublime Executive Suite, YiuTeung Mansion bedrooms are bright and spacious. Neutral shades of white, beige and cream allow quirky furnishings and subtle Chengdu artwork to shine. Relax and recharge, before saluting the sun with a yoga session in the hotel’s fitness centre. Then make your way to the Magnolia All-Day Restaurant for an authentic dining experience.

Of course, as a UNESCO City of Gastronomy, Chengdu is bursting with fiery (and hugely varied) flavours of its own. Sample everything from delicate wontons to guo kuei (a deep-fried pancake). Then taste tradition in one of the city’s many teahouses. When you’ve had your fill, learn about Chengdu’s history at Chengdu Museum or the serene Wenshu Monastery. Here for giant cuddly bears? Be sure to stop off at the Giant Panda Breeding Research Base.

While inside, pared-back design keeps every room light and spacious, with floor-to-ceiling windows and doorways opening out onto private terraces.

From high-end boutiques to bustling markets, this sprawling metropolis beats with life. item.title: Hangzhou Muh Shoou Xixi Hotel
item.descriptionTitle: A striking addition to China’s ‘lake district’ in Hangzhou
item.descriptionText:
Every element of Hangzhou Muh Shoou Xixi Hotel is connected to the landscape it belongs to. Flowing lines, pools of water and open-sided structures bring a sense of the outdoors in – as does weather-worn stone, wooden accents and water-washed marble features. Step inside, circling ancient persimmon trees, into a boutique hotel that’s truly a part of its setting.

From the bedrooms to the beautifully-designed restaurant, glass walls and open spaces frame views of the wetlands. In summer, swim in the outdoor infinity pool in the shade of trees. And when the temperature dips, cocoon yourself in Ye Qiu, the hotel bar. All year round – and all day long – Xi Yin restaurant serves delicious Chinese cuisine in a sleek, minimalist dining room that lets the food (and views) shine.

If the scenery from Hangzhou Muh Shoou Xixi Hotel proves irresistible, you’re well placed to venture out into the natural wetlands that surround the hotel. Row in a traditional Chinese sculling boat from the Muh Shoou private jetty for a back-in-time way to get back to nature. Or explore West Lake Scenic Spots and Historic Sites, Nine Creeks and Eighteen Gullies – all close by.

Add to the mix  a never-too-much-to-ask European dining, butler service and a stunning infinity pool, and you have a truly luxurious escape.

A spacious garden deck is perfect for holiday reading, while a state-of-the-art fitness suite is available for personal workouts.

item.title: Vallie Hotel
item.descriptionTitle: A tranquil retreat in the heart of the forest within Hangzhou
item.descriptionText:
There’s nowhere quite like Hangzhou Vallie Hotel. Nestled in the forest far away from the city, but close to the serene atmosphere of Liuhe Pagoda Culture Park, it feels like a romantic escape from another era. Once a collection of homes for local tea farmers, the buildings blend beautifully into the tree-filled landscape, with temple-style roofs and golden light that filters through the branches come nightfall.
